name: Clay look
summary: Forms that look modelled in soft clay: round edges, one matte material and soft, even light.
how: Round every edge; set the fillet at 10% to 20% of the form size.
Use one matte material with no texture and no specular highlight.
Light with one large soft source and a soft contact shadow under the form.

origin.note: Early films such as The Sculptor's Nightmare animate figures modelled in clay.

adoptions.via: Icon sets render each object in 3D with one matte, clay-like material and soft light.
Claymorphism gives cards and buttons the round, puffed form of clay.

sources.title: Michael Frierson, Clay Animation: American Highlights 1908 to the Present (1994)
